statement: Main experimental confounder: every benchmark question is anchored to a fact date near a specific gold version, so any monotone timestamp term supplies a partially label-revealing shortcut; the temporal weight lambda can be tuned to upweight whichever version the gold passage came from, inflating accuracy without demonstrating temporal reasoning. A second confounder is that aggregate accuracy mixes current and historical query regimes with opposite expected effects, letting recency bias and post-amendment staleness cancel out and hide both.

evidence.quote: we present a benchmark of 312 expert-validated, time-sensitive German statutory QA pairs spanning three categories
more recent and highly cited documents can improve the final macro F1 score up to 10%
